stage0033b_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「It's all right, Queen $$リリーナ$$.
　The shelter under this Peace Memorial Hall
　is one of the safest places in the world」

stage0033b_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「From what we've learned,
　Federation High Command has decided
　on a tactical weapon strike...」

stage0033b_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「It will end in failure,
　broadcasting their own incompetence to the world」

stage0033b_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$ナナリー$$
「...You don't intend to stop this fight, do you?」

stage0033b_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「Hehe... you two really do hate war, don't you.
　But surely you don't wish
　for humanity's history to end?」

stage0033b_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「What are you trying to say?」

stage0033b_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「To put it simply, history
　is like a waltz that never ends」

stage0033b_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「War, peace, revolution, the steps repeat forever...
　But once I become ruler of the Earth Sphere,
　history will change」

stage0033b_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「A lasting peace neither $$ＵＣＷ$$ nor $$ＡＤＷ$$ achieved...
　I will be the one to bring it about.
　Yes... a new era is about to begin」

stage0033b_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$ナナリー$$
（The world my brother risked his life for...
　to be destroyed like this...）

stage0033b_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$リリーナ$$
（Not yet, $$ナナリー$$...
　There's still hope left）

stage0033b_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$マリーメイア$$ Soldier
「Lord $$デキム$$, it appears $c has
　broken through the first defense line」

stage0033b_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$デキム$$
「I'll grant them that much credit.
　But they can't have come through unscathed」

stage0033b_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$マリーメイア$$ Soldier
「Yes, two warships and half the squad
　are still fighting at the first defense line」

stage0033b_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$マリーメイア$$ Soldier
「Even the units that reached this
　Peace Memorial Hall should be badly worn down」

stage0033b_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$デキム$$
「They were up against a $$サーペント$$ force
　committed purely to defense.
　I'll praise them for breaking the line this fast」

stage0033b_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$デキム$$
「Let their defeat be the dawn of a new era」

stage0033b_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$オットー$$
「This is all that made it through...!」

stage0033b_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Macross Quarter and $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$,
　half the mobile fleet is fighting at the first defense line」

stage0033b_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$オットー$$
「Damn it...!
　Even if it was a race against time,
　our losses are nothing to laugh at!」

stage0033b_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「Captain $$オットー$$, even so, we have to do this!」

stage0033b_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$ノイン$$
「The enemy defense force outnumbers us
　by roughly three to one」

stage0033b_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$バナージ$$
「So each of us has to face down
　three of them alone...!」

stage0033b_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$シンジ$$
「No way...!
　And our units are already badly damaged...!」

stage0033b_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$シン$$
「$$バナージ$$, $$シンジ$$!
　If you're not confident, fall back!」

stage0033b_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$バナージ$$
「...I'll do it.
　Because this is a fight that shouldn't happen...!」

stage0033b_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「I've made up my mind...!
　I'll disable as many enemy mobile suits as I can!」

stage0033b_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$ヒルデ$$
「$$ヒイロ$$ and the others are coming too!」

stage0033b_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Been waiting for you guys.
　So, where's $$五飛$$?」

stage0033b_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$カトル$$
「Let's handle this ourselves for now」

stage0033b_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Still can't play well with others, huh.
　Well... if I could, I'd have passed
　on a reckless fight like this too」

stage0033b_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Showing up to join us at a time like this,
　gotta hand it to you guys」

stage0033b_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$トロワ$$
「I have a debt to repay
　for taking the name $$トロワ・バートン$$」

stage0033b_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$デュオ$$
「That's a rare joke, coming from you.
　Where's $$カトル$$?」

stage0033b_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$カトル$$
「No need to ask, $$デュオ$$.
　I feel the same way you do」

stage0033b_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Got it.
　Guess that means neither of us
　hates this world all that much」

stage0033b_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$オットー$$
「All units, charge!
　Crush the enemy MS force and save the Vice Minister!」

stage0033b_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Fighting that many
　in this condition is rough」

stage0033b_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$トロワ$$
「For us, this is nothing new」

stage0033b_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I know.
　In this fight... winning or losing means nothing」

stage0033b_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$アムロ$$
「All units, cover $$ヒイロ$$!
　Break the defense force and open a path!」

stage0033b_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$アムロ$$
「We can't sustain a long fight!
　We settle this in five minutes!」

stage0033b_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$カレン$$
「Go, $$ヒイロ$$!
　I'll cover you!」

stage0033b_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Enemy units approaching from the rear!」

stage0033b_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$オットー$$
「Damn it! We'll be caught in a pincer!」

stage0033b_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$エマ$$
「I knew it, $$マリーメイア$$ and Neo Zeon
　were working together!」

stage0033b_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$カミーユ$$, don't think about him right now」

stage0033b_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Get distracted on the battlefield and you'll die!」

stage0033b_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Dragged in to help an outdated old man
　and his little doll of a princess」

stage0033b_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Don't forget, $$ギュネイ・ガス$$.
　This is a plan the Colonel devised」

stage0033b_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「You're the one who shouldn't forget, $$アンジェロ・ザウパー$$.
　Just who leads Neo Zeon」

stage0033b_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
（Just as I thought, I don't like him...）

stage0033b_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$オットー$$
「$$マリーメイア$$ ahead, Neo Zeon behind...」

stage0033b_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$レイアム$$
「What are your orders, Captain?」

stage0033b_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$オットー$$
「At a time like this, we push forward...!
　Show weakness and they'll exploit it!」

stage0033b_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$シン$$
「The defense force is wiped out!」

stage0033b_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$レイアム$$
「$$ヒイロ・ユイ$$ broke through the enemy defense force!」

stage0033b_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$オットー$$
「But what's he planning to do from here!?」

stage0033b_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Tch... so I couldn't finish off
　this so-called $c after all」

stage0033b_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「No matter.
　The mission's done, we're pulling back」

stage0033b_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Our job ends here.
　Fall back」

stage0033b_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
（$c... $$カミーユ・ビダン$$...
　We'll settle this next time）

stage0033b_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$マリーメイア$$ Soldier
「Neo Zeon is falling back!」

stage0033b_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$デキム$$
「That Red Comet!
　So he'll only lend the bare minimum of help!」

stage0033b_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$デキム$$
「No matter.
　Deploy every reserve $$サーペント$$」

stage0033b_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$宗介$$
「They still had that many left in reserve...!」

stage0033b_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$カトル$$
「At this rate, $$ヒイロ$$ is going to...!」

stage0033b_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Like hell I'll let that happen!!」

stage0033b_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$デキム$$
「Fools, all of them!
　Trying to be shields for that Gundam!」

stage0033b_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$デキム$$
「$$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ and $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$, feared as the strongest
　in their own worlds, look pretty pathetic now!」

stage0033b_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$マリーメイア$$ Soldier
「Lord $$デキム$$, the broadcast is ready」

stage0033b_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$デキム$$
「Good...!
　Broadcast this scene to the entire world!」

stage0033b_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$ミヒロ$$
「Captain!
　The $$マリーメイア$$ Army intends to broadcast this fight!」

stage0033b_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$オットー$$
「Damn it!
　They mean to advertise their victory to the world!」

stage0033b_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$デキム$$
「$$サーペント$$ squadron, don't let up the attack!
　Fire at will!」

stage0033b_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$セイナ$$
「The world we fought and bled to create...
　I came to watch it start to collapse, but...」

stage0033b_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$セイナ$$
「Never thought I'd be here
　to witness $$紅月カレン$$'s final moment...」

stage0033b_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$デキム$$
「All that's left is the winged Gundam!
　Shoot it down!!」

stage0033b_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$カレン$$
「The radiant barrier won't hold much longer!」

stage0033b_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$セイナ$$
「Farewell, $$紅月カレン$$.
　The last of the Black Knights...」

stage0033b_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$セイナ$$
「When you fall, my last shred of pride truly ends...
　Then, I'll just give this crumbling world a push」

stage0033b_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$カレン$$
「$$ヒイロ$$!
　The $$マリーメイア$$ Army's rattled!」

stage0033b_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$カレン$$
「What are you planning to do!?」

stage0033b_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「$$デキム・バートン$$...
　You have the shelter shield raised, don't you」

stage0033b_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「The shield is perfect, is it」

stage0033b_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「Of course it is!
　Learn just how powerless you all are!」

stage0033b_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$マリーメイア$$ Soldier
「A beam from Wing Zero!
　Direct hit!」

stage0033b_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「W-what a pathetic man...!
　Doing this won't change anything!」

stage0033b_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「Are you scared, $$マリーメイア$$?」

stage0033b_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$カレン$$
「$$ヒイロ$$!
　$$リリーナ$$ and $$ナナリー$$ are right there!」

stage0033b_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$カレン$$
「This is no different from what
　Supreme Command is trying to do!!」

stage0033b_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$カレン$$
「If you use the Buster Rifle again,
　even Wing Zero won't hold up!」

stage0033b_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$カレン$$
（$$ヒイロ$$... sacrificing himself and
　$$リリーナ$$ just to prove he'll keep fighting...）

stage0033b_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$カレン$$
（Is this what $$トレーズ$$ Khushrenada meant
　by playing the loser...!?）

stage0033b_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$セイナ$$
「Even as he chooses to become a loser...
　that Gundam hasn't lost its pride...」

stage0033b_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$マリーメイア$$ Soldier
「A second hit, and shields are down to half!」

stage0033b_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$デキム$$
「Impossible!
　This shelter's built to withstand
　even an N2 depth charge!」

stage0033b_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$マリーメイア$$ Soldier
「Wing Zero's aim is accurate to
　hundredths of a degree! One more hit
　here and this shelter will collapse!」

stage0033b_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$デキム$$
「Stop it!!
　$$リリーナ$$ Peacecraft is
　in here too!」

stage0033b_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「It's no use.
　He, $$ヒイロ$$ Yui, knows what he must do.」

stage0033b_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$カレン$$
「Wait, $$ヒイロ$$!
　A transmission's coming in!」

stage0033b_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$カレン$$
「$$ゼロ$$... let me ask you one thing.」

stage0033b_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$カレン$$
「That man, Seiji Takechi... do you remember him?」

stage0033b_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Of course.
　He served the Black Knights' Squad Zero...
　a captain who led many young members.」

stage0033b_04:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Capable, with strong leadership,
　but a clumsy man who struggled to
　balance ideals against reality...」

stage0033b_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$カレン$$
「That's all I needed to hear.」

stage0033b_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$セイナ$$
（Thank you, $$紅月カレン$$...
　and the winged Gundam...）

stage0033b_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$セイナ$$
（I'm sorry, $$タクマ$$...
　It's a little late, but... we'll
　keep fighting, just a bit longer...）

stage0033b_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$セイナ$$
（The fight to live... in this world...）

stage0033b_04:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$カレン$$
「What's left of the $$マリーメイア$$ army has retreated.」

stage0033b_04:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$カレン$$
「You don't need to see $$リリーナ$$?」

stage0033b_04:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Don't you want to see $$ゼロ$$?」

stage0033b_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$カレン$$
「No need.
　When the time comes, we'll surely meet again.」

stage0033b_04:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$ミヒロ$$
「Word from the Quarter. It says
　the first defense line's battle ended too.」

stage0033b_04:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$レイアム$$
「The units that fell back
　took damage, but we've confirmed they're safe.」

stage0033b_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$オットー$$
「Phew... what a mess.
　Now that the $$マリーメイア$$ army's silenced,
　Supreme Command's rampage should stop too.」

stage0033b_04:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$レイアム$$
「It's too soon to relax, Captain.
　Neo Zeon's declared war on us.」

stage0033b_04:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$オットー$$
「I hear you, but let us rest a little,
　just this once, me and everyone on the $c.」

stage0033b_04:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Understood.
　But right after resting, we'll move
　straight into strategy meetings.」

stage0033b_04:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$オットー$$
「...Our reward's Brig. Gen. $$サイガス$$'s sour face...」

stage0033b_04:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$カレン$$
「Let's go meet everyone, $$ヒイロ$$.
　This mission succeeded because
　everyone on the $c worked together.」

stage0033b_04:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$オットー$$
「All units, hurry!
　If we don't settle this in one minute,
　we'll only wear ourselves down after!」

stage0033b_04:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Operation time, 5 minutes elapsed!
　We're at our limit!」

stage0033b_04:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$オットー$$
「Damn it, the operation's failed!
　All units, fall back!」

stage0033b_04:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Tch!
　My heart's just not in this, after all!
　I'll pull back here!」

stage0033b_04:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Sloppy, for an Enhanced Human straight from
　the Supreme Commander. Says little for his superior.」

stage0033b_04:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Maybe it's time the name Red Comet
　passed on to the Colonel.」

stage0033b_04:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「This clinging feel of gravity on my skin,
　I still can't get used to it! Falling back!」

stage0033b_04:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「'Guard Captain,' what a laugh.
　In the end, you're just an impostor's pet.」

stage0033b_04:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「In short, surpassing the Colonel...
　no, the Supreme Commander, that's my role.」

stage0033b_04:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
（$$五飛$$...
　I'm sure that in this battle, you'll find
　the answer you've been looking for...）

stage0033b_04:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Being outmatched like this...
　It's been a while since I thought of $$オペレーション・メテオ$$.」

stage0033b_04:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$デュオ$$
「You watching, old man $$デキム$$!
　We've fought by rejecting the all-out
　war you tried to wage!」

stage0033b_04:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$デュオ$$
「I've been against your methods from day one!
　So a little disadvantage won't stop me,
　I'm going all out!!」

stage0033b_04:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$トロワ$$
「I know.
　The soldiers who follow $$マリーメイア$$
　are people who lost their way in this world.」

stage0033b_04:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$カトル$$
「Right...!
　So let's aim to avoid their cockpits
　as much as possible when we attack!」

stage0033b_04:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「$$デキム$$...!
　Your ambitions end here!」

stage0033b_04:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$ノイン$$
「$$ゼクス$$, don't push yourself...!
　The gap in strength is too great to close!」

stage0033b_04:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「What's needed now isn't victory...
　it's the will to fight.」

stage0033b_04:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「If we fail to show that,
　the world will give rise to
　a second Milliardo Peacecraft!」

stage0033b_04:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$アムロ$$
（Are you watching, $$シャア$$...!
　This is the result of the answer you chose!）

stage0033b_04:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$アムロ$$
（Can you even see reality...!
　You must know what a selfish intellectual's
　revolution leads to!）

stage0033b_04:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「This mobile suit...!
　The one that picked a fight with me before!」

stage0033b_04:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Don't take it personally, $$カミーユ$$ Bidan!
　Taking down the Supreme Commander's favorite
　will prove my own strength!」

stage0033b_04:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「The Supreme Commander's war declaration
　really rattled you! I can feel your fury from here!」

stage0033b_04:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「The Colonel said to let him run loose,
　but I owe this one from our last fight!」

stage0033b_04:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$バナージ$$
「You're the escort for that mobile suit
　they call the $$シナンジュ$$...!」

stage0033b_04:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Now fight, Split-horn!
　Show me your true power!」
